compliance.summary: The page presents GoGloby as an Applied AI Engineering provider selling a product-and-engineering offer, rather than the approved staffing and recruiting agency. Reposition the page, and verify or remove the unsupported claims, timelines, security statements, contact details, and branch-office information.

llm_problems.title: Applied AI provider positioning
llm_problems.issue: The page repeatedly describes GoGloby as an Applied AI Engineering partner that turns engineering into AI-native production, contradicting the approved company description and positioning.
llm_problems.fix: Replace the Applied AI Engineering positioning with the approved staffing and recruiting positioning.
llm_problems.subject: GoGloby positioning
llm_problems.source_value: Staffing and recruiting agency specializing in hiring Data & AI Engineers

llm_problems.title: Obsolete product names
llm_problems.issue: The page uses obsolete product names, including “4x” and “AI Intelligence Layer”; the current name is AI Development Intelligence Layer.
llm_problems.fix: Remove obsolete product names and use current terminology only where it accurately describes the staffing service.

llm_problems.title: Discontinued engineering offer

llm_problems.fix: Remove the discontinued product and development-service offer, and describe only the current recruiting and staffing services.

llm_problems.title: Industry classification is wrong
llm_problems.issue: The page classifies GoGloby as “AI & Software Development,” while the Fact Sheet identifies its category as staffing and recruiting and says it is not a software development shop.
llm_problems.fix: Change the industry classification to match the company’s staffing and recruiting category.
llm_problems.subject: GoGloby industry

llm_problems.title: Unverified client count
llm_problems.issue: The claim that GoGloby is trusted by 100+ companies across 10+ industries is not supported by the Fact Sheet.
llm_problems.fix: Remove the unverified company and industry counts.
llm_problems.subject: GoGloby client count

locations.quote: Trusted by Hasbro, TATA, EverCommerce, and 100+ companies across 10+ industries.

llm_problems.title: Cost reduction figure conflicts
llm_problems.rule: Glossary §2: Nearshore Data and AI Engineers Staffing; Glossary §10
llm_problems.issue: The page claims 30 to 40% lower cost, while the Glossary states nearshore engineers cost 40% to 50% less.
llm_problems.fix: Correct the cost comparison to the documented range or remove it.
llm_problems.subject: Nearshore cost reduction

llm_problems.title: Unverified shortlist timeline
llm_problems.issue: The promised shortlist in 3–5 days is not supported by the sources, which specify 4–6 weeks to offer for recruiting and 2–3 weeks to start for staffing.
llm_problems.fix: Remove the unsupported shortlist promise or replace it with a documented service timeline.
llm_problems.subject: Shortlist timeline
llm_problems.source_value: 4–6 weeks to offer; 2–3 weeks to start

llm_problems.title: Unsupported deployment timeline
llm_problems.rule: Fact Sheet: Services; Glossary §2: Nearshore Data and AI Engineers Staffing
llm_problems.issue: The page promises forward deployment in under 4 weeks, which is not the documented timeline for either current service.
llm_problems.fix: Remove this timeline or use the documented timeline for the applicable service.
llm_problems.subject: Engineer deployment timeline
llm_problems.source_value: 4–6 weeks to offer; 2–3 weeks to start

locations.quote: how our engineers forward-deploy in under 4 weeks.

llm_problems.title: Insurance coverage overstatement
llm_problems.rule: Fact Sheet: Services; Fact Sheet: Legal and security
llm_problems.issue: The page includes professional liability in the $3M coverage claim, while the Fact Sheet specifies $3M data and cyber-liability insurance.
llm_problems.fix: Remove the unsupported professional-liability coverage claim and align the coverage description with the Fact Sheet.
llm_problems.subject: Insurance coverage

locations.quote: $3M combined liability coverage (cyber, data and professional).

llm_problems.title: Unverified zero-exposure claim
llm_problems.issue: The absolute “Zero exposure” security claim is not established by the Fact Sheet’s documented security controls.
llm_problems.fix: Remove the absolute security claim or limit it to documented controls.
llm_problems.subject: Security claim
